system_texts: The Industrial Designer should produce a working design.
The User Interface Designer should specify the technical functions.
The Marketing Expert should come up with user requirements.
The group will go ahead with what we have and proceed with the current plan.
The product should have the least number of functions possible to improve user-friendliness.
gold_texts: Use EUR 25 as the product selling-price target.
The project manager stated an aim to sell EUR 50 million worth of product.
Allow production costs of half the EUR 25 selling price, i.e. EUR 12.50 per remote.
Use television and video control as a provisional starting scope while reserving the possibility of additional features.
